visual_overrides.core_identity: An enormous natural cave bat with a broad membrane wingspan and powerful clawed roosting feet.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Very broad wings with a compact mammal torso, large pointed ears, and strong clawed feet; often hanging inverted or partly opening its wings.

scene_overrides.size_impression: Large enough to dominate a cave or mine chamber while retaining light natural bat proportions.
scene_overrides.natural_posture: Hanging securely by clawed feet from a visible overhead surface or moving in controlled natural flight.
